cards.text: Jesus has just been on the other side of the sea, where a whole town begged Him to leave their region (Matthew 8:34). So He gets into a boat and crosses back over.

cards.question: Jesus' boat crosses over the water. Where does He come to?

cards.text: Just then, some men bring Jesus a man who's paralyzed, lying on a mat. No appointment, no waiting room, just straight to Jesus.

cards.question: Some men bring a paralytic on a mat to Jesus. When Jesus sees their ___, He speaks to the paralytic.
Jesus' first words to the paralytic tell him to get up and walk.

cards.text: Instead, Jesus says to him, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.” I think that man's heart just did a flip.
Now some scribes are watching, the experts in God's law. They don't say a word out loud, but oh, friend, they are TALKING on the inside.

cards.question: The scribes just heard Jesus tell the paralytic his sins are forgiven. What do they say to themselves?

answers.text: This man must be a prophet
This man should heal him first

cards.question: The scribes keep their thoughts to themselves, but Jesus knows what they're thinking.

cards.text: Jesus says to them, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?” You ever think something real quiet in a meeting and the boss just... ANSWERS it?
Then Jesus asks them, “Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?” Friend, if I'm one of those scribes, I am studying my shoes REAL hard right now.

cards.question: Jesus is about to show the scribes something about the Son of Man, the name He uses for Himself (Mark 2:10). What does He want them to know?

answers.text: He has authority on earth to forgive sins
He answers to the priests in Jerusalem
He speaks for the elders of His town

cards.question: Jesus turns to the paralytic with a command. Along with getting up and going home, what does Jesus tell him to pick up?
After Jesus speaks, the man still needs the others to carry him home.

cards.text: The man gets up and goes home, just like that. He came in lying on a mat and he leaves on his OWN TWO FEET, and friend, it took me YEARS to get out of one junk drawer!

cards.question: The crowds just watched the paralyzed man get up and go home. How do they react?

answers.text: They are filled with awe and glorify God
They are afraid and beg Jesus to leave
They argue with the scribes about Jesus

cards.text: The crowds glorify God, who had given such authority to men. Oh, friend, that's the kind of moment that gives a stamper goosebumps.
